meta.phase-name: Payload CRUD, Revisions, And Publish Receipts

phase-summary.outcome: Completed the next authoring slice on top of the working Payload import/export/publish loop. The docs-site content editor now supports browser-based pack JSON editing, project custom schema creation, docs-site/Payload platform extension creation, visible revision history, and publish-job receipts backed by new DB collections. The canonical import/bootstrap/publish path runs again end-to-end and now reads engine source contracts directly instead of depending on packaged engine dist resolution.

file.description: Added revision history records for pack documents, custom schemas, and platform extensions.
Added publish receipt records that persist pipeline commands, export file lists, engine writes, and failures.
Recorded revisions and publish jobs, returned them through project detail, and moved content-editor registry consumption onto engine source contracts.
Upgraded the content-app workspace with pack JSON editing, custom-schema/platform creation panels, and revision/publish history views.
Serves the contract registry from engine source so the editor sees the same canonical pack list the import/export pipeline uses.
Added a defensive generated-codec fallback so canonical content-source loading does not block the authoring loop when schema/codegen drift exists.
Generated and applied the migration for draft revisions and publish jobs.
Documented the new revision/publish receipt layer and the engine-source contract resolution path for authoring.

commands.command: pnpm --dir docs-site exec payload generate:types --config payload.config.ts
pnpm --dir docs-site exec payload migrate:status --config payload.config.ts

decision.summary: The content-editor authoring loop now resolves the canonical pack registry from engine source instead of depending on packaged engine dist runtime decoding.
decision.impact: Removes a fragile failure mode from import/export/bootstrap while the packaged runtime contract decoder catches up to live content schema shape.

decision.summary: The browser editor ships as a JSON-first workspace instead of waiting for fully schema-generated field editors.
decision.impact: Authors can already create and edit project data in the DB now, while richer field-driven editors remain a follow-on slice.

tests.test: pnpm --dir docs-site exec payload generate:types --config payload.config.ts
pnpm --dir docs-site exec payload migrate:status --config payload.config.ts

data-state.item: The canonical Payload project `canonical-game-content` still resolves to project id `1`.
Bootstrap import succeeds for all 34 canonical pack entries.
Publish succeeds and records a publish-job id while exporting project files and syncing engine/KAPLAY artifacts.

next.action: Add validation runs and diff-aware publish gating so authors can see contract problems before writing back into engine files.
Add edit flows for existing custom schemas and platform data, plus schema-driven editors that move beyond raw JSON textareas.
